-- USV-CAT-3M vessel supervisor (runs on the autopilot, ArduPilot Lua applet)
-- Drives the USV-1620 vessel control board:
--   RELAY1 -> contactor arm (kill): dropped on disarm, kill switch aux fn,
--             or when either hardwired chain channel (board opto feedback on
--             GPIOs) reports open — the hardwired chain also cuts the coil
--             circuit directly; this supervision only adds telemetry + latch.
--   RELAY2 -> all-round white nav light: ON whenever armed or afloat (always,
--             per SYS-07 "on whenever afloat" — we keep it on from boot).
-- Feedback: chain channel states + contactor command are sent as named floats
-- so the GCS shows kill-path health (TC-01 evidence).

local CHAIN_CH1_PIN = 50      -- board J1: opto ch1 feedback (RC kill relay)
local CHAIN_CH2_PIN = 51      -- board J1: opto ch2 feedback (deck mushroom)
local LOOP_MS = 100

gpio:pinMode(CHAIN_CH1_PIN, 0)
gpio:pinMode(CHAIN_CH2_PIN, 0)
relay:on(1)                    -- nav light on from boot (SYS-07)

local latched = false

function update()
  local ch1 = gpio:read(CHAIN_CH1_PIN)   -- true = chain closed
  local ch2 = gpio:read(CHAIN_CH2_PIN)
  local chain_ok = ch1 and ch2

  if not chain_ok then
    latched = true               -- discrepancy or open: latch until disarm
  end
  if not arming:is_armed() then
    latched = false              -- disarm clears the latch
  end

  if arming:is_armed() and chain_ok and not latched then
    relay:on(0)                  -- RELAY1 index 0: contactor armed
  else
    relay:off(0)
  end

  gcs:send_named_float("KILL_CH1", ch1 and 1 or 0)
  gcs:send_named_float("KILL_CH2", ch2 and 1 or 0)
  gcs:send_named_float("KILL_ARM", (arming:is_armed() and chain_ok and not latched) and 1 or 0)

  return update, LOOP_MS
end

return update()

/* PUC-1720 drive interface firmware - board configuration
 *
 * Board: PUC-1617 drive interface board (Raspberry Pi Pico module)
 * Cart:  PUC-CART-24V powered utility cart
 *
 * Pin map matches PUC-1617 rev A. Change only through an ECO that revs
 * both the board and this firmware together.
 */
#ifndef PUC_CONFIG_H
#define PUC_CONFIG_H

/* ---- Joystick (2-axis analog, centre-return) -------------------------- */
#define PIN_JOY_X_ADC        26      /* ADC0, 0-3.3 V via divider from 0-5 V */
#define PIN_JOY_Y_ADC        27      /* ADC1 */
#define JOY_CENTRE_COUNTS    2048
#define JOY_DEADBAND_COUNTS  150     /* ~7 % half-scale; SYS-02 asks <= 10 % */
#define JOY_FAULT_LO         100     /* below = broken wire / short to GND  */
#define JOY_FAULT_HI         3995    /* above = short to supply             */

/* ---- E-stop (dual channel, monitored) --------------------------------- */
#define PIN_ESTOP_CH1        10      /* opto input, active low = chain open */
#define PIN_ESTOP_CH2        11
#define PIN_CONTACTOR_EN     12      /* gate driver for SW80 coil MOSFET    */
#define ESTOP_REACTION_MS    50      /* budget; SYS-05 total <= 200 ms      */
#define ESTOP_DISCREPANCY_MS 500     /* ch1 vs ch2 disagreement -> latch    */

/* ---- Sabertooth 2x60 packet serial ------------------------------------ */
#define UART_SABER           uart0
#define PIN_SABER_TX         0
#define PIN_SABER_RX         1       /* not used by packet serial; reserved */
#define SABER_BAUD           9600
#define SABER_ADDRESS        128     /* DIP: packet serial, address 128     */
#define SABER_TIMEOUT_MS     100     /* controller-side serial watchdog     */

/* ---- Battery ---------------------------------------------------------- */
#define PIN_VBATT_ADC        28      /* ADC2, 100k/10k divider: 30.4 V FS   */
#define VBATT_DIVIDER        11.0f
#define VBATT_LOW_CUTOFF     21.0f   /* LiFePO4 8s empty                    */
#define VBATT_LOW_DERATE     22.4f   /* start limiting speed below this     */
#define I2C_BATT             i2c0
#define PIN_BATT_SDA         4
#define PIN_BATT_SCL         5
#define BATT_METER_ADDR      0x0B    /* smart-battery style meter           */

/* ---- Drive limits ----------------------------------------------------- */
#define DRIVE_MAX_CMD        127     /* Sabertooth full scale               */
#define DRIVE_RAMP_MS        400     /* 0 -> full in 400 ms                 */
#define LOOP_PERIOD_MS       10
#define WATCHDOG_TIMEOUT_MS  100

#endif /* PUC_CONFIG_H */

# PUC-1720 — drive interface firmware

Firmware for the PUC-1617 drive interface board (Raspberry Pi Pico / RP2040) of the
PUC-CART-24V powered utility cart.

## What it does

100 Hz control loop:

1. **Joystick** (2-axis analog, 0–5 V through a divider): deadband, wire-break /
   short detection — any electrical fault reads as neutral (CTL-02).
2. **E-stop** (dual-channel, opto-monitored): either channel open → neutral command
   + contactor enable released within 50 ms; channel discrepancy > 500 ms latches a
   fault until power cycle. The hardwired chain opens the Albright SW80 coil circuit
   independently of firmware — the MOSFET sits in series with the chain (ELEC-01/02).
3. **Mixing**: arcade mix (throttle ± turn) → Sabertooth 2x60 packet serial at
   address 128, M1 = left pair, M2 = right pair. The Sabertooth serial watchdog is
   the backstop if the loop dies; the RP2040 hardware watchdog resets on a 100 ms hang.
4. **Battery**: 100k/10k divider on ADC2 (30.4 V full scale), low-voltage speed
   derate from 22.4 V down to a quarter-speed floor at 21.0 V (PWR-01); best-effort
   SoC read from a smart-battery meter on I2C0.

## Build

Standard pico-sdk out-of-tree build:

```
mkdir build && cd build
cmake .. -DPICO_SDK_PATH=/path/to/pico-sdk
make
```

Produces `puc_drive_interface.uf2` for drag-drop flashing (work instruction
"flash firmware" step) — in production use `picotool load` in the traveler.

## PLM

- Software item: **PUC-1720** (this tree, zip import)
- Board: **PUC-1617** drive interface board (KiCad project `pcb/drive-interface`)
- Pin map lives in `include/config.h` and must rev together with the board — one ECO
  covering both items.

# USV-CAT-3M — ArduPilot Rover (Boat) parameter baseline
# Satisfies: SYS-03/NAV-01 (link-loss failsafe), SYS-04/CTL-01 (RC override),
#            SYS-05/SAF-01 (kill paths), SYS-06/NAV-02 (RTK station keeping)
# Frame / outputs -------------------------------------------------------------
FRAME_CLASS      2          # Boat
SERVO1_FUNCTION  73         # ThrottleLeft  -> ESC port
SERVO3_FUNCTION  74         # ThrottleRight -> ESC starboard
SERVO5_FUNCTION  0          # (USV-1620 kill arm via relay/PWM below)
RELAY1_FUNCTION  1          # contactor arm (USV-1620 J1 pin: kill PWM)
RELAY2_FUNCTION  1          # nav light (USV-1620 J1 pin: light PWM)
# Failsafe (SYS-03: loiter at 10 s, SmartRTL at 60 s) -------------------------
FS_ACTION        3          # SmartRTL or RTL
FS_TIMEOUT       10         # s before failsafe action begins (loiter hold)
FS_GCS_ENABLE    1          # GCS loss triggers failsafe
FS_GCS_TIMEOUT   60         # s of GCS loss before SmartRTL
FS_THR_ENABLE    1          # RC loss failsafe armed
FS_CRASH_CHECK   1
SRTL_POINTS      500
# Manual override (SYS-04) ----------------------------------------------------
RC_OVERRIDE_TIME 0.5        # s: stick activity takes helm within 500 ms
MODE_CH          8
FLTMODE1         0          # Manual
FLTMODE4         10         # Auto
FLTMODE6         5          # Loiter
# GNSS / navigation (SYS-06) --------------------------------------------------
GPS_TYPE         9          # DroneCAN (Here4)
EK3_SRC1_POSXY   3          # GNSS
EK3_SRC1_YAW     2          # GPS+compass fusion
WPNAV_SPEED      1.5        # m/s survey speed
LOIT_RADIUS      0.5        # m station-keeping radius target (RTK)
# Battery / power (SYS-01, vbatt via USV-1620 divider on ADC) -----------------
BATT_MONITOR     4
BATT_VOLT_MULT   11.0
BATT_LOW_VOLT    22.4
BATT_CRT_VOLT    21.0
BATT_FS_LOW_ACT  2          # RTL on low battery
BATT_FS_CRT_ACT  1          # hold on critical
# Scripting (nav light + kill supervision Lua) --------------------------------
SCR_ENABLE       1
SCR_HEAP_SIZE    102400

# USV-CAT-3M — vehicle configuration bundle

Deployed configuration for the autopilot (Pixhawk 6X, ArduPilot Rover/Boat):

- `ardupilot/rover.param` — parameter baseline: frame/outputs, link-loss failsafe
  (loiter 10 s → SmartRTL 60 s, SYS-03), RC override 500 ms (SYS-04), DroneCAN RTK
  GNSS (SYS-06), battery monitor via the USV-1620 divider (SYS-01), scripting on.
- `lua/vessel_supervisor.lua` — applet driving the USV-1620 vessel control board:
  contactor arm relay with chain-feedback latch (SYS-05), nav light always on
  afloat (SYS-07), kill-path health telemetry for TC-01 evidence.

This bundle is the released Software item for BOM part **USV-1920 Vehicle
Configuration**; the board it drives is **USV-1620**. Flash/verify step lives in
the (future) Phase-3 water-test traveler: load params, install Lua, verify
KILL_CH1/2/ARM telemetry.

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.13)

include(pico_sdk_import.cmake)

project(puc_drive_interface C CXX ASM)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)

pico_sdk_init()

add_executable(puc_drive_interface
    src/main.c
    src/joystick.c
    src/estop.c
    src/sabertooth.c
    src/battery.c
)

target_include_directories(puc_drive_interface PRIVATE include)

# UART0 -> Sabertooth packet serial, I2C0 -> battery meter
target_link_libraries(puc_drive_interface
    pico_stdlib
    hardware_adc
    hardware_uart
    hardware_i2c
    hardware_watchdog
)

# USB CDC for service console, UART reserved for the motor controller
pico_enable_stdio_usb(puc_drive_interface 1)
pico_enable_stdio_uart(puc_drive_interface 0)

pico_add_extra_outputs(puc_drive_interface)
